The '''Badger''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] 
produced by [[Meirm Speeder Emporium]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The bike featured a wide, rounded front section and a seat with access to pedals and a handlebar for its [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]; the handlebars were attached to the bike's nose. Two thrusters were situated beneath and behind the pilot's seat. The Badger's front section was largely decorated with a [[Color/Legends|blue]] and white color scheme, while the bike's grill was finished in dark gray. A central stripe on the nose continued in the same gray before ending in a touch of metallic green in front of the pilot's seat. The bike's exhausts were painted in the same green hue.

==Behind the scenes==
The Badger first appeared in the [[Cartel Market]] in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''; the store was added to the game on [[November 15]], [[2012]].<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20121115|text=Welcome to Game Update 1.5: HK-51 Activated}}</ref>
